rules.verification_evidence: court orders, electoral rolls, government notifications, independent reporting and original video may assess an eligible spoken claim but cannot themselves introduce a claim card

source_levels.original_unedited_transcript: Not authenticated for every one of 125 reviewed speaker-attributed public statements. The latest 13 eligible statements are attributed to reported speeches, recorded briefings or in-person field interviews.
source_levels.edited_interview: named Q&A or edited newspaper conversation
source_levels.recorded_short_clip: published media clip with publisher summary, speaker may be unidentified
source_levels.reported_spoken_remarks: reporter-attributed public speech or press interaction, full audio may not be verified

Obtain signed peace bonds and magistrate orders from October 10-14

Obtain October 14 court affidavits by Delhi Police Commissioner and Union Home Secretary, underlying Raisina Hill mobile internet notification, and Supreme Court resolution of the alleged contempt; affidavits are assertions, not findings.
Obtain the Delhi High Court October 15 application, any interim order and next listing on the October 16 protest; a granted hearing is not a stay.
Authenticate Yogendra Yadav's 15 October Federal interview from full programme footage; edited print excerpts are available.
Obtain full May 28 Reuters Bhushan rushes, August university talk recording, October 7 joint press-conference footage and attendee list.
Authenticate timing and entire recording of Saurav Das thanking AISF/SFI at CPI headquarters, reported 1 August.
Independently verify any post-7 October formal coalition governance or party-to-CJP operational financing, without inferring from co-presence.
Get the full unedited 11 October APCR Kolkata event recording to attribute Bhushan's exact spoken statements and context.

Obtain and timecode complete original 15 October Press Club of India video, documenting remarks by Dipke, Bhushan, Bora, Sibal, Raj, Salauddin and SFI/AISF representatives; identify who spoke and whether an on-stage disruption is fully captured.

Acquire original DMRC affidavit with annexed station restrictions, Delhi Police instructions, train-run records and Supreme Court final disposal before treating operator submissions as judicial findings.
Retrieve signed 15 October Delhi High Court PIL order and 3 November listing; distinguish no interim restraint from positive permission for a 16 October action.

Obtain full unedited 13 October published New Yorker Yogendra Yadav interview recording and underlying election-roll numbers, opinion polling and police/eyewitness evidence for October 10 route/barricade account.
Obtain the ECI 15 October 2026 signed SSR circular and compare its Form 7 procedures to prior public guidance; independently track 12 Nov draft, 11 Dec objection deadline and 4 Jan final rolls.
Obtain unedited 15 October Neha Bora Press Club speech and correct/complete Bangladesh comparison; distinguish political comparison from an actual endorsement of violence.
Reconcile Reuters ~500 with early Indian Express ~1000 and later ~2000 near Connaught Place by time, location, photographer and counting method. Do not publish one count as verified.

Retrieve all 16–17 October Dipke/Bora custody registers, legal grounds, transfers, counsel/medical access, release orders, signed Section 163 BNSS and NDMC orders, and the Supreme Court's operative hearing note.
Authenticate New York Asian American Writers' Workshop dinner beneficiary, full Rushdie/Nair remarks and avoid conflating literary event fundraising with any alleged CJP remittance.
Investigate Mumbai local CJP permit, whether official appeals were circulated, named coordinator role and organiser response. Keep this evidence of one city separate from national leadership claims.
Investigate the non-CJP-organised SFI and AAP 16 October marches as separate entities and score potential new public gatherings 17–19 October only after independent observation.

Added ECI 15 October SSR report and Union ministry clarification as context only. 17 October early: thirteen more eligible spoken statements PC-113–125, including a prior 15 October press-conference comparison, 16 October public opponent/government statements, Delhi and Mumbai street interviews, and 15 October New York literary fundraiser solidarity. Total 125. Police notices, social-media-only allegations and organisation custody posts remain context.
